title: 唐詩八首
author: 李白、王維等
blurb: Eight short, famous Tang poems, mostly four lines each, ideal for your first real reading.
note: Tang dynasty poems from the 8th century, in the public domain worldwide.

title: 孔乙己
author: 鲁迅
blurb: A short story about a failed scholar who drinks at a village tavern, one of the most famous works of modern Chinese fiction.
note: Published in 1919, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931).

title: 故乡
author: 鲁迅
blurb: A man returns to his hometown and finds that both the place and his childhood friend have changed.
note: Published in 1921, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931).

title: 狂人日记
author: 鲁迅
blurb: China's first modern vernacular short story, the diary of a man who fears everyone around him wants to eat him.
note: Published in 1918, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931).

title: 論語·學而
author: 孔子弟子
blurb: The first chapter of the Analects, sixteen short sayings on learning and character, in classical Chinese.
note: Composed more than 2,000 years ago, in the public domain worldwide.

title: 西遊記 第一回
author: 吳承恩
blurb: The Monkey King is born from a stone, finds a home at Flower-Fruit Mountain, and sets out to learn immortality.
note: Written in the 16th century, in the public domain worldwide.

title: 落花生
author: 许地山
blurb: A family harvests peanuts, and over dinner the father says what the humble peanut can teach them. A school favorite. Written in 1922, it often writes the possessive de with an older character, di.
note: Published in 1922, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 許地山 died in 1941.

title: 差不多先生传
author: 胡适
blurb: The comic life of Mr. More-or-Less, who thinks close enough is always good enough, right up to the end.
note: Published in 1919, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 胡適 died in 1962.

title: 一件小事
author: 鲁迅
blurb: A rickshaw puller stops to help an old woman, and the passenger in a hurry sees himself in a new light. Very short.
note: Published in 1919, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 魯迅 died in 1936.

title: 匆匆
author: 朱自清
blurb: A short prose poem on how the days slip away, one of the best-loved essays in modern Chinese.
note: Published in 1922, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 朱自清 died in 1948.

title: 背影
author: 朱自清
blurb: A son remembers his father crossing the railway tracks to buy him oranges. Perhaps the most famous essay in Chinese.
note: Published in 1925, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 朱自清 died in 1948.

title: 再别康桥
author: 徐志摩
blurb: Saying goodbye to Cambridge. A short poem many Chinese readers know by heart.
note: Published in 1928, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 徐志摩 died in 1931.

title: 从百草园到三味书屋
author: 鲁迅
blurb: Lu Xun remembers the wild garden he played in as a boy, and the old-style school he was sent to next.
note: Published in 1926, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 魯迅 died in 1936.

title: 社戏
author: 鲁迅
blurb: Boys row through the night to a village opera, then steal beans on the way home. Lu Xun at his warmest.
note: Published in 1922, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 魯迅 died in 1936.

title: 荷塘月色
author: 朱自清
blurb: A walk by a lotus pond on a moonlit night. Rich, careful description, a classic of modern prose.
note: Published in 1927, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 朱自清 died in 1948.

title: 阿Q正传
author: 鲁迅
blurb: The novella of Ah Q, a village laborer who turns every defeat into a victory in his head. Lu Xun's best-known work.
note: Published in 1921, so it is in the US public domain (published before 1931). 魯迅 died in 1936.

title: 西遊記
author: 吳承恩
blurb: The Monkey King, Tang Sanzang and their companions travel west for the scriptures. Complete, all 100 chapters of the Ming novel Journey to the West.
note: Wu Cheng'en, 16th century; public domain worldwide. Text: Wikisource, Shidetang-based edition.

title: 紅樓夢
author: 曹雪芹、高鶚
blurb: The rise and fall of the Jia family and the tragic love of Baoyu and Daiyu. Complete, all 120 chapters of Dream of the Red Chamber.
note: Cao Xueqin (ch. 1-80) and Gao E (ch. 81-120), 18th century; public domain worldwide. Text: Wikisource collated edition (Gengchen base for 1-80, Cheng-jia for 81-120).

title: 三國演義
author: 羅貫中
blurb: Heroes and schemers fight over the fallen Han empire: Liu Bei, Cao Cao, Zhuge Liang. Complete, all 120 chapters of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
note: Luo Guanzhong, 14th century, in the Mao Zonggang revision; public domain worldwide. Text: Wikisource.

title: 水滸傳
author: 施耐庵
blurb: 108 outlaws gather at Liangshan Marsh. Complete, all 120 chapters of Water Margin.
note: Shi Nai'an, 14th century; public domain worldwide. Text: Wikisource, the 120-chapter Yuan Wuya edition.
